title: Anthropic Posts $17 Bn in Q3 Revenue, Swings to Operating Loss
script:
Anthropic hit seventeen billion dollars in revenue for the third quarter of 2026.
The company swung to an operating loss during this same period.
This San Francisco firm maintains its focus on developing the Claude AI model.
The financial report highlights the massive cost of training advanced AI systems.
Analytics India Magazine notes these figures reflect the current state of the industry.
Scaling compute power requires significant capital investment for the company.
Will high revenue eventually outweigh these rising infrastructure costs?
